description: This is a Python script for benchmarking framework overhead in PyTorch, supporting add operations in both graph and eager modes, with configurable options for benchmarking parameters.

classes.name: BenchmarkConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for benchmarking parameters such as warmup and iteration counts.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for module-specific parameters including function, number of parameters, and graph mode.

methods.name: parse_op_args
methods.description: Splits operation argument string into a list.

methods.name: print_results
methods.description: Prints benchmarking results with latency in microseconds.

methods.name: benchmark_simple_fn
methods.description: Performs benchmarking of a traceable PyTorch function wrapped in a module.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up benchmarking, and execute the benchmark.
